long_biography.plain_text:
Mountain House shows the scale of the property work William A. ‘Bill’ Pope directed at SunChase Holdings. The group secured entitlements for a planned California community, broke ground, developed residential and commercial parcels, and eventually sold most of its remaining housing land. Pope led the group through that programme after advancing from chief operating officer to president and chief executive.

A different project illustrates his work with complex, long-horizon assets. Pope and S. Robson Walton acquired the unfinished Hokuli‘a community in Hawaii in 2014, with SunChase taking the development role. Its combination of land, lending and distressed-property experience reflects the multi-cycle discipline that has defined Pope's long stewardship of the private group.
